criteria.text: A workload moves from the data centre to a cloud cluster and back with no change to the application
criteria.how: Move a test application with its addresses and time it both ways.

criteria.text: A failover of a business application to the cloud meets the agreed recovery time and point
criteria.how: Run the recovery plan to the cloud cluster in test mode and record the result.

criteria.text: An idle cloud cluster is hibernated and resumed within the agreed time, and the saving is shown
criteria.how: Hibernate a cluster overnight, resume it, and compare the cost.

criteria.text: Data that must stay in the country is shown to stay there, with evidence an auditor accepts
criteria.how: Produce the residency evidence for one workload and review it with compliance.

criteria.text: The same security policy applies to a workload in the data centre and in the cloud
criteria.how: Move a workload and check that its policy follows it.

criteria.text: The cost of the test footprint is compared on demand, reserved and against existing commitments, with per-core licences included
criteria.how: Price the same footprint three ways and review it with finance

readiness: A cloud account and landing zone approved by the cloud team
Network link between data centre and cloud sized and tested
The data residency rule and the evidence compliance expects
A test application that may move, with its owner
Budget and a cost alert for the test capacity
